errorCodes.meaning: The recipient holds no key by that identifier, or the key is not one its caller may name.
The recipient already holds group state for this room. Its current epoch is carried in `details.epoch`.

Response.title: Rooms Owner Group Create — response payload

member.description: The DID the owner's leaf identifies — the subject of the owner's membership and authority credentials. Absent means the caller.

roomId.description: The room whose group is formed. Its identity exists already; the recipient MUST hold a signing key for it.

signingKeyId.description: The room's signing key, named as to rooms/owner/issue-membership. Control of it is the entitlement: forming the room's group is the founding act of its membership.
